selection.criteria: 7shifts provider-published llms index was enumerated once, with its finite 147-operation survey reconstructed from the explicitly linked official OpenAPI fragments; no recursive reference crawl was used.

connectors.evidence_source: Provider-published https://developers.7shifts.com/llms.txt direct API Reference index and its linked /reference/*.md OpenAPI 3.0.2 fragments.
connectors.counting_note: The official index has 158 reference entries. Authentication, Postman Collection, two non-callable webhook guide pages, six explicitly deprecated external-mapping duplicates, and one explicitly deprecated forecast-overrides duplicate are excluded, leaving exactly 147 provider operations. Every selected page embeds exactly one OpenAPI 3.0.2 operation at version 2026-06-01; the deterministic source index records each URL and hash.
connectors.selection_reason: direct official-reference extraction after the generic recursive materializer hit its bounded traversal limit; the finite immutable survey is preserved exactly without relaxing ordinary artifact provenance checks
